source_text: Potest et aliter: catechumenus mundatus ducit peccata sua longe. Baptismus dimittit in eremum.
pass_a_gloss: It-can also otherwise: catechumen cleansed leads sins his far. Baptism dismisses into desert.
pass_b_english: Read another way: the cleansed catechumen leads his sins far off. Baptism dismisses them into the desert.
